items.title: CVE-2026-90622 | GNU libredwg 0.13.4 Layer Encoding src/dwg.spec DWG_TABLE null pointer dereference (Issue 1269)
items.author: vuldb.com
items.content: A vulnerability has been found in GNU libredwg 0.13.4 and classified as problematic. This impacts the function DWG_TABLE of the file src/dwg.spec of the component Layer Encoding. items.title: CVE-2026-90583 | kagisearch smallweb up to 0ecb9c48edbf98dc7e934b54fbac43869e64b4cf Query String Rendering app/sw.py index qs cross site scripting (Issue 854)

items.content: A vulnerability identified as problematic has been detected in kagisearch smallweb up to 0ecb9c48edbf98dc7e934b54fbac43869e64b4cf. The affected element is the function index of the file app/sw.py of the component Query String Rendering. Performing a manipulation of the argument qs results in cross site scripting. Exploitability requires a raw HTTP request carrying unencoded double-quote characters in the query string - Werkzeug's request.query_string returns the raw request-target, and ordinary browsers percent-encode " as %22, so the payload only lands via netcat/curl-style raw sockets.

items.title: CVE-2026-88790 | proma-ai Proma up to 0.19.37 File Preview Service file-preview-service.ts resolveTargetPath file_path path traversal (Issue 1366)
items.author: vuldb.com
items.content: A vulnerability was found in proma-ai Proma up to 0.19.37 and classified as problematic. Affected is the function resolveTargetPath of the file apps/electron/src/main/lib/file-preview-service.ts of the component File Preview Service. Such manipulation of the argument file_path leads to path traversal. This vulnerability is uniquely identified as CVE-2026-88790. Local access is required to approach this attack. Moreover, an exploit is present. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. The PoC's candidateBasePaths parameter name does not match the current IPC API (0.19.52 uses FileAccessOptions with internal getPreviewCandidateBasePaths()). The reporter likely targeted 0.16.3 where the IPC handler accepted raw string[] base paths. The core vulnerability - basename-collision fallback - is independent of the parameter name and is confirmed in source.

Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the component Web-based Management Interface. Such manipulation leads to improper input validation. This vulnerability is uniquely identified as CVE-2026-73769. The attack can be launched remotely. No exploit exists.

items.title: CVE-2026-79322 | Mageplaza Blog Plugin up to 4.3.2 RelatedProduct Block /mpblog/post/view ID sql injection
items.author: vuldb.com
items.content: A vulnerability identified as critical has been detected in Mageplaza Blog Plugin up to 4.3.2. Affected is an unknown function of the file /mpblog/post/view of the component RelatedProduct Block. This manipulation of the argument ID causes sql injection. This vulnerability is handled as CVE-2026-79322. The attack can be initiated remotely. There is not any exploit available.

items.title: CVE-2026-79323 | Magefan Blog GraphQL Plugin up to 2.2.1 blogComments GraphQL query information disclosure
items.author: vuldb.com
items.content: A vulnerability categorized as problematic has been discovered in Magefan Blog GraphQL Plugin up to 2.2.1. This impacts the function blogComments GraphQL query. The manipulation results in information disclosure. This vulnerability is known as CVE-2026-79323. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. No exploit is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-54694 | NationalSecurityAgency skills-service up to 4.4.1 Account Registration Endpoint StringHighlighter.js eval firstName/lastName/nickname input validation
items.author: vuldb.com
items.content: A vulnerability was found in NationalSecurityAgency skills-service up to 4.4.1. It has been rated as critical. This affects the function eval of the file StringHighlighter.js of the component Account Registration Endpoint. The manipulation of the argument firstName/lastName/nickname leads to improper input validation. This vulnerability is traded as CVE-2026-54694. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. There is no exploit available. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

items.title: CVE-2025-51619 | sycon DPC Latency Checker up to 1.4.0 IOCTL interface dpc.sys ExSetTimerResolution null pointer dereference (EUVD-2025-210885)
items.author: vuldb.com
items.content: A vulnerability was found in sycon DPC Latency Checker up to 1.4.0. It has been declared as problematic. The impacted element is the function ExSetTimerResolution of the file dpc.sys of the component IOCTL interface. Executing a manipulation can lead to null pointer dereference. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. This vulnerability appears as CVE-2025-51619. The attack requires local access. There is no available exploit.

items.title: CVE-2025-24890 | GitoxideLabs Gitoxide Identity Checking gix-sec/src/identity.rs is_path_owned_by_current_user input validation
items.author: vuldb.com
items.content: A vulnerability has been found in GitoxideLabs Gitoxide and classified as problematic. items.title: CVE-2026-87929 | MaxSite CMS up to 109.6 Session Management config.php is_login hard-coded key
items.author: vuldb.com
items.content: A vulnerability classified as critical was found in MaxSite CMS up to 109.6. Affected by this issue is the function is_login of the file application/config/config.php of the component Session Management. Executing a manipulation can lead to use of hard-coded cryptographic key . This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. This vulnerability is tracked as CVE-2026-87929. The attack can be launched remotely. No exploit exists.
